title: Robo-Dopamine 2.0: History-Conditioned and OOD-Aware Process Reward Modeling for Robotic Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2608.15680v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models improve robotic manipulation but remain vulnerable to compounding errors, scene changes, and off-trajectory states. Reinforcement learning can refine pretrained VLA policies, yet sparse success signals hinder exploration, while engineered dense rewards are costly and task-specific. Existing learned visual reward models often rely on static before-after observations, causing temporal ambiguity and weak discrimination between robustness-preserving variations and task-invalid failures under out-of-distribution (OOD) execution. translated_title: 罗博-多巴胺2.0：基于历史条件和分布外感知的过程奖励建模用于机器人操作
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型改善了机器人操作，但仍易受复合错误、场景变化和偏离轨迹状态的影响。强化学习可以优化预训练的VLA策略，但稀疏的成功信号阻碍探索，而人工设计的密集奖励成本高昂且特定于任务。现有的学习型视觉奖励模型通常依赖静态的前后观察，导致时间模糊性，并且在分布外（OOD）执行下难以区分鲁棒性保持的变化和任务无效的失败。我们引入了罗博-多巴胺2.0，一种具有成对预测接口的历史和分布外感知的过程奖励模型。它结合了（1）基于历史条件的成对奖励，使用源对齐参考面板用于合成OOD查询，并使用观察到的回放历史用于在线查询，同时保留查询端点，以及（2）一个分布外感知的有符号进度空间，该空间表示...
tldr: 本文提出了Robo-Dopamine 2.0，一种结合历史条件和分布外感知的过程奖励模型，通过成对预测接口和源对齐参考面板，有效解决了VLA模型在分布外执行中的奖励建模问题，提升了机器人操作的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Robo-Dopamine 2.0, a history-conditioned and OOD-aware process reward model with pairwise prediction, which enhances reward modeling for VLA policies under out-of-distribution execution, improving robotic manipulation robustness.
